title: Optimize join key allocation
constraints: Preserve indexed probe join and hash join matching semantics
rationale: Join key construction happens in inner join loops. Hash join still needs owned Vec<Value> keys, but indexed probe join can compare candidate rows directly without allocating temporary key vectors.
steps: Preallocate row_key output using the known join key width
Add direct indexed row key comparison helper
Use direct comparison in indexed probe join candidate filtering
Run focused join regressions and cargo check
expected_impact: Reduces temporary allocation pressure in join matching, especially for indexed probe joins with multiple candidate rows.
